फिल्ममेकर अली अब्बास ज़फर ने अपनी आने वाली रोमांटिक एक्शन-ड्रामा फिल्म Beparwah की शूटिंग पूरी कर ली है। 🎬
इस फिल्म में पहली बार Ahaan Panday और Sharvari की जोड़ी साथ नज़र आने वाली है। 🤩
डायरेक्टर ने पंजाब के सेट्स से तस्वीरें शेयर करते हुए सोशल मीडिया पर इस बात का ऐलान किया है। 📸
अली अब्बास ज़फर का कहना है कि Yash Raj Films (YRF) के साथ दोबारा काम करना घर वापस लौटने जैसा है। ❤️
आदित्य चोपड़ा के प्रोडक्शन में बनी यह फिल्म 26 मार्च 2027 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी। 🗓️
आपको अहसान पांडे और शर्वरी की यह नई जोड़ी देखने के लिए कितना इंतज़ार करना पड़ेगा? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.text:
Filmmaker Ali Abbas Zafar has wrapped up shooting for Beparwah , his upcoming romantic action-drama starring Ahaan Panday and Sharvari. The director announced the development on social media, sharing a behind-the-scenes video featuring pictures from the film’s sets in Punjab.
In his Instagram post, Zafar reflected on the experience of making the film and returning to Yash Raj Films (YRF), where he previously directed Sultan and Tiger Zinda Hai . He wrote, “It’s a Film Wrap on BEPARWAH In Punjab , it’s been an incredible emotion Journey , coming back to direct for @yrf feels like coming back home ❤️. Thank you to the entire Cast and Crew of the Film , can’t wait to bring this to Theatres . Rab Rakha .”
Sharvari, who stars in the film alongside Ahaan Panday, reacted to the post with a comment that read, “Sir! ♥️🧿🥹🤞🏻”
Beparwah brings Ahaan Panday and Sharvari together for the first time. The film marks another project for Panday following the attention he received for Saiyaara , while Sharvari continues to build her filmography with projects across genres.
The film’s title was announced by YRF along with a teaser poster, revealing its theatrical release date. Produced by Aditya Chopra and directed by Zafar, the romantic action-drama is scheduled to arrive in cinemas worldwide on March 26, 2027.
Zafar’s association with YRF includes Sultan , starring Salman Khan, and Tiger Zinda Hai , featuring Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif. With Beparwah , he returns to the production house for a new story that combines romance and action.
